entities.title: Templates
entities.summary: A starting file for three of the document kinds, and the lines a repository's agent instructions need.
entities.purpose: Holds feature.md, journey.md and subsystem.md, starting files for the feature, user-journey and subsystem kinds of 04-document-taxonomy.md, and agent-instructions.md, the block an adopting repository pastes into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. An adopter copies a file, fills it in and deletes what does not apply.
boundaries: The kinds themselves, and which one a fact belongs in, are defined in 04-document-taxonomy.md; the templates only give them a shape.
The marks in the templates are placeholders, and so mentions rather than claims; once a copy is filled in, every mark in it is a claim about the adopter's system.
